_doc: Health > Tracked, declared: the today cards, in order, drawn like Google Fit and Samsung Health (a ring toward `goal` when there is one, the value, the unit). Tapping a card opens its detail: a Day (hourly) / Week / Month (daily) chart from Health Connect's aggregate API, the history list, and a manual entry written back to Health Connect. `agg` = sum (buckets add up) or avg (heart rate, weight); `entry_label`/`entry_unit` = the manual entry field; `entry_minutes` = how long a manual interval record lasts, ending now (active minutes and sleep take their length from the value itself). Kotlin (TrackedHc.kt) maps each id to its Health Connect record and aggregate; test/test-me-health-tracked.sh pins the ids to that mapping and every write to build.json::ui.permissions.health.write.
